teacher_tagline_en: Send one message in German. I’ll correct the key mistakes and help with your next reply.

loader_messages: 🎵 Checking the rhythm of the sentence...
locale.better_audio_please: Voice works better for this kind of practice 🎙️ Next time, send a short voice message.
locale.translation_fallback_missing: I don’t have a translation for this message yet.
locale.hints_intro: Here are a few options for your next reply:
locale.hints_empty: I don’t have suggestions for this message yet. Try the next reply.
locale.hi_message_text:
Hi! Let’s start with a short check 👋
Send one short voice or text message (1-2 sentences), and I’ll reply with:
✅ transcript
✅ corrections + short explanation
✅ what to say next
locale.choose_voice_mode_text: How would you like to receive my replies: voice or text? 🎧💬
locale.msg_too_long: This voice message is too long 🙂 Please send a recording of up to 90 seconds.
locale.msg_voice_length_tip: For more focused practice, try to keep each voice message to 30–45 seconds 🙂
locale.msg_to_bot: 🤖→🤖 If you’re a bot, send one spoken sentence 😄
locale.msg_error_command: I don’t know that command yet.
locale.msg_next_step: Now send a short voice message (1-2 sentences) 🎙️ I’ll correct 1-2 important things and explain them briefly.
locale.stats_footer: Subscription details and management are in the mini-app below.
locale.msg_limit_reached:
You’ve already used the free practice limit.
To continue, open the subscription in the mini-app with the button below.
locale.msg_tts_limit_reached: You’ve reached the weekly limit for voice replies. Check /stats.
locale.msg_too_short: I couldn’t hear enough. Try a slightly longer voice message.
locale.msg_feedback_prompt: Thanks. Please send feedback as text or a voice message 🎙️
locale.msg_feedback_needs_text_or_voice: Please send feedback as text or voice message 🎙️
locale.msg_needs_text_or_voice: Please send a text or voice message only 🎙️
locale.onboarding_start_practice_text: You can choose a topic or continue freely. Send a voice or text message anytime.
locale.onboarding_example_text: Example 1 (commute): ❌ Even on Monday, I go to my work with half-closed eyes. ✅ Even on Monday, I go to work with half-closed eyes. 🧠 Rule: We say go to work without "my". Example 2 (remote work): ❌ On Fridays, I work in home in pajamas during meetings. ✅ On Fridays, I work from home in pajamas during meetings. 🧠 Rule: For remote work, we say work from home, not "in home". Now it’s your turn 🙂 Send 1-2 short sentences.
locale.onboarding_voice_cta_text: Okay. Send a short voice message (1-2 sentences) 🎙️
locale.onboarding_text_cta_text: Okay. Send a short text message (1-2 sentences) ✍️
locale.onboarding_showcase_no_mistakes_text:
No mistakes here 👏
If you want to see how I correct things, send a sentence with an intentional mistake.
For example:
❌ Yesterday I go to work by bus.
locale.onboarding_complete_full_text:
Your profile is ready 🚀

A few quick notes:
• Your starting level is A1. You can change it anytime to A1, A2, B1, B2, or C1.
• Use the buttons below the chat to change your level and reply type: voice or text.
• The mini-app has more settings, feedback, and account options.

Send your next message to continue practicing 🔥

Onboarding is finished.

about_self.prompt: Say where you are from and what you do.
about_self.example: Hallo, ich bin Alex. Ich komme aus der Ukraine und arbeite im Design.

daily_life.prompt: Say in one sentence what you did this morning.
daily_life.example: Heute Morgen habe ich Kaffee getrunken und bin zur Arbeit gegangen.

travel.prompt: Say where you would like to travel.
travel.example: Ich möchte Italien besuchen, weil ich das Essen und die Geschichte liebe.
